changes.meee2_relevance: 推断：'reachable wherever your users already are'与meee2锚点5(peripheral层多入口极短路径触达)有结构性重叠信号；'artifacts persistence + state snapshots'涉及artifact持久化但原文描述为快照式备份恢复而非live link(锚点2要求的实时链接)，且未见'人=慢session/AI=快session同一协议'的人机同构表述(锚点1)。整体结构重叠中等，建议下次评估是否加入常规监控列表。

key_findings: Tier1/Tier2均被EGRESS_BLOCKED拦截，落入Tier3 WebSearch兜底
本次审查的候选中，AgentSky同时命中≥2个watch_keywords(harness/agent/artifact)且具备可验证原文依据，为本次唯一记录的new_entrant
AgentSky的多入口触达('wherever your users already are')与artifacts持久化机制是本次抓取中与meee2结构最接近的信号，建议加入下次sources.json监控

alerts.headline: Claude Code v2.1.225/226持续加固跨session消息基础设施：修复headless session下SendMessage滞留无提示的问题，并'Enhanced cross-session messaging capabilities via SendMessage'
alerts.evidence: 「Fixed cross-session messages remaining parked without notice in headless sessions」／「Enhanced cross-session messaging capabilities via SendMessage」
alerts.action_suggestion: 持续追踪跨session SendMessage/ListAgents/crossSessionInbound这条基础设施线的迭代节奏——本次是可靠性加固而非新架构，暂不需要紧急响应，但建议下次报告继续标记为观察重点，评估其何时会从'AI-to-AI消息'扩展出'人=慢session'的显式协作框架
